items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: George Thow was the jazz trumpet player when I was in it. Sonny something was the trombone player.

ctx.x: George Thow was the jazz trumpet player when I was in it. Sonny something was the trombone player. Sonny, oh, goodness I can’t think of his last name.
